verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is GPU accelerator hardware (DGX/HGX systems). User-configurable autonomous background automations are an agent or software-product capability, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows B300 itself ships such an automation feature: the BMC/Redfish management, DGX OS, and Kubernetes/NIM deployment items are host-platform or developer building blocks, not product-level automations.
